note_retry: Pairs that failed on SUPERSEDED code or under-provisioned hardware, not on anything about the models. Each carries retry_reason. Three of four are provisioning; Mistral is undiagnosed and may join genuine attrition. Sized from the shard on BOTH axes — card from the largest single checkpoint (the runner holds one at a time), disk from the sum of weights, which is the pair of mistakes that cost y-02 six pairs and y-04 one.
note_card: Card floor = model_gb*1.25 + 6 + 4, matching size_frac()'s actual request plus slack. The previous 1.45x rule disagreed with the runner and put a 14 GB model on a 24 GB card with no headroom. Two sizing rules that disagree is worse than one that is wrong, because the manifest check passes and the run still dies.
